summary: The 'I am QSB Kernel ... continuity_status ... Leading beliefs ... Local symbolic interpretation' paragraph is generated by symbolic_reply() in src/tower/kernel_dialogue_adapter.py:1982 and unconditionally appended to every non-execution answer at line 2098-2099. Worse: topic detection (_wants_eqsb_topic) only runs for READ_ONLY_DIAGNOSTIC intent at line 2062, but '_classify_intent' classifies most natural-language questions ('what is Floor 41 doing right now?', 'why is the Penthouse plain?', 'what hardware are you running on?') as GENERAL_CONVERSATION because they don't contain any READ_ONLY_DIAGNOSTIC_TERMS. So topic-specific answers never fire, and the canned identity paragraph is the only thing the user ever sees.

root_causes.description: introspection_blocks.append(base_reply) runs for every non-EXECUTION_REQUEST intent — so identity paragraph is appended to every answer.
root_causes.fix: Only append base_reply when (a) user explicitly asked for identity/status, or (b) no other topic block was produced.

root_causes.description: _wants_eqsb_topic only runs for READ_ONLY_DIAGNOSTIC intent — but most natural questions classify as GENERAL_CONVERSATION because READ_ONLY_DIAGNOSTIC_TERMS focuses on 'audit', 'review', 'diagnose'. Floor-specific topics never fire.
root_causes.fix: Run topic detection for all non-EXECUTION_REQUEST intents.

root_causes.description: No topic exists for penthouse, hardware, code_observatory, claude_changes, dashboard_repair — so even with RC2 fixed, those questions still fall back to identity.
Local model paraphrase wraps even short answers, sometimes amplifying the canned text. The wrapper text 'The kernel is active and stable...' identical for every reply.
root_causes.fix: Disable wrapper when topic block fired and is already specific.

test_prompts_observed_behavior.Kernel, what is Floor 41 OANDA doing rig: FAIL — returns identity paragraph only; floor41_oanda topic never fires because intent=GENERAL_CONVERSATION.
test_prompts_observed_behavior.Kernel, what is OpenClaw supervising?: PARTIAL — matches rebuild_v1 topic if intent=READ_ONLY_DIAGNOSTIC, but trigger phrase requires specific wording.
test_prompts_observed_behavior.Kernel, what is broken in the dashboard?: PARTIAL — 'what is broken' matches READ_ONLY_DIAGNOSTIC trigger, then systems_check fires.

fix_plan: Add identity intent detection (terms: 'who are you', 'what are you', 'your identity', 'status', 'who am i talking to').
Skip base_reply (identity paragraph) when topic blocks are present OR intent is not IDENTITY.
Run _wants_eqsb_topic for any intent except EXECUTION_REQUEST.
Add topics: penthouse_command, floor42_binance, hardware_observatory, code_observatory, dashboard_repair, claude_changes.
Expand floor41_oanda triggers to catch natural phrasings.
Make local model wrapper opt-in via QSB_LOCAL_MODEL_WRAPPER_ENABLED env (default off).
